title: Female hold countdown uses Sino-Korean seconds
summary: Female Korean voice pack hold timer (버텨!!!) now speaks seconds as Sino-Korean TTS (십구…일) instead of native-Korean rep clips (열·아홉·하나). Exercise rep counts unchanged.
testFocus: Settings > Voice Coach > female pack + hold enabled. Start count with hold (e.g. 19s). Hold countdown should say 십구, 십팔…삼, 이, 일 — not 열 아홉, 여덟…둘, 하나. Rep counts during exercise still native Korean.

deploy.frontend: GitHub Pages via push to main

asIs: Female hold seconds used rep-* clips with native Korean (열 아홉, 여덟…하나).
toBe: Female hold seconds use Sino-Korean TTS (십구, 십팔…이, 일) for second-based countdown.
